title: Issue map: a search option, a repository option, and faded outside blockers
story: The issue map can now show only the issues a GitHub search matches, or another repository's issues. A blocker the search leaves out stays on the map as a faded, dashed box, and shows blocked when its own blockers are open, so a story waiting on it never looks free. Without either option the map looks and behaves as before.

checks.criterion: A search limits the map, and a blocker the search left out is drawn faded.
checks.steps: In a made-up repository, issue A is open and blocked by open issue B, and only A carries label bug. Run python .claude/skills/issue-map/scripts/issue_map.py --search "label:bug" --open.
checks.expected: A shows the blocked padlock; B is a faded, dashed box whose card says Outside the search; the banner names label:bug; the printed line ends in + 1 outside the search.

checks.steps: Run the generator with --repo <some-owner>/<some-repo> --open, then again with --repo nope.
checks.expected: The first page's title and banner name that repository. The second run is refused with --repo takes owner/name and nothing is rebuilt.

checks.criterion: With neither option, the map is built as today.
checks.steps: Run the generator with no option.
checks.expected: Every issue, no faded boxes, and the same counts line as before.
